note: How the boss cards are put together from the two wikis' boss categories. The wikis split one fight over several pages or templates (one per wiki, one per form, a '(boss)' and a '(normal encounter)' page). 'groups' joins them into one card: each form is one fight or one body part, and the members of a form are the same fight on different pages (the first member's numbers win, the others fill gaps). 'drop' lists templates that are field monsters, not boss fights. 'distinct' lists cards whose names look alike but are different fights. build.py fails if two cards are left with the same base name and are not listed in 'distinct'.
